title: Localizing Emergent Failures in Agentic AI: Recovering Minimal Repair Families via Counterfactual Replay
abstract: arXiv:2608.29228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Failures in agentic AI systems can arise from interactions among messages exchanged by multiple large language model (LLM) agents. Pointwise attribution cannot distinguish a jointly necessary repair from alternative singleton repairs. We formulate Minimal Repair Family Recovery (MRFR): recovering all inclusion-minimal event sets whose counterfactual replay restores task success within a declared size bound. We propose Graph-Constrained Joint Replay (GCJR), which slices failure-relevant events from an execution dependency graph, constructs graph-feasible singleton and pair candidates, and verifies them by replay with paired clean counterparts. For fixed replay outcomes, GCJR is exact within its declared graph domain. On 90 in-scope cases from a 120-DAG controlled benchmark, GCJR achieves 1.000 Family Exact Match while reducing mean replay calls from 56.3 to 25.3 (55.1%) relative to exhaustive search. translated_title: 局部化智能体AI中的涌现性失败：通过反事实回放恢复最小修复族
translated_abstract: 智能体AI系统中的失败可能源于多个大语言模型（LLM）智能体之间所交换消息的交互作用。逐点归因方法无法区分联合必要的修复与其他可替代的单一修复。本文提出了最小修复族恢复问题（MRFR）：在声明的大小界限内，恢复所有包含最小的事件集合，使这些集合的反事实回放能够恢复任务成功。作者提出了图约束联合回放方法（GCJR），该方法从执行依赖图中切分出与失败相关的事件，构建图可行的单元素与成对候选集，并通过与配对的干净对照样本进行回放来验证这些候选。对于固定的回放结果，GCJR在其声明的图域内是精确的。在一个包含120个DAG的受控基准的90个适用案例上，GCJR达到了1.000的族精确匹配率，同时将平均回放调用次数从56.3次降至25.3次（相对于穷举搜索减少55.1%）。在一个包含24个案例、四个智能体的LLM试点实验中，该方法也展现出有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出最小修复族恢复问题（MRFR）及图约束联合回放方法（GCJR），通过从执行依赖图中切分失败相关事件、构建图可行候选并用反事实回放加以验证，能够精确且高效地定位多智能体LLM系统中由消息交互引发的涌现性失败，同时将回放调用次数较穷举搜索减少约55%。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates Minimal Repair Family Recovery (MRFR) and proposes Graph-Constrained Joint Replay (GCJR), a method that localizes emergent failures in multi-agent LLM systems by recovering all inclusion-minimal repair event sets via counterfactual replay, achieving exact family-level attribution while reducing replay calls by about 55% compared to exhaustive search.
